key_patterns: HomePage.tsx is a no-router View state machine: `type View = 'list' | 'quiz' | 'result' | 'history'`. State: currentQuiz: QuizDetail | null, selected: Record<number, number> (question q.n -> chosen option index), result: SubmitResult | null. Sub-components QuizList / QuizTaking / QuizResult / HistoryView are defined in the same file (except HistoryView which is imported). loadQuiz(quizId) fetches QuizDetail via getQuiz and sets view to 'quiz'. handleSubmit builds answers: number[] via quiz.questions.map(q => q.n in selected ? selected[q.n] : -1), calls submitAnswers, on success sets result, calls append(makeRecord({quizId,title,score,total})) EXACTLY once inside the async callback (not in render/useEffect, to avoid StrictMode double-record), then setView('result'). QuizResult renders a conic-gradient score-ring using inline style `{ '--percent': percent } as CSSProperties`. All UI copy is Japanese. CSS classes: .card .question .option .btn .btn.primary .btn.small .progress .progress-bar .progress-bar-fill .progress-label .quiz-actions .quiz-heading .score-ring .result .empty-state .home-link .quiz-list .quiz-card etc. Uses radio inputs with name={'q'+q.n}. legend is float:left width:100% then next sibling clears both.
